A1.justification: Both PDFs describe PCDreamer and provide readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and four supplementary pages. Matching retained content across relocation and renumbering supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: V1 reports original PCN and ShapeNet-55 experiments, quantitative ablations, and supplementary ScanNet completion examples.

after.justification: V2 retains original experiments and adds unseen-category evaluation, an SDS-Complete comparison, and results on additional real-world and cropped inputs.

M1.justification: The core generation, fusion, consolidation, and loss formulations remain unchanged. V2 introduces a limited procedural adaptation for general partial clouds: selecting an informative view and producing an incomplete depth image before applying the existing generation pipeline with stronger conditioning.

E1.justification: PCN and ShapeNet-55 coverage is retained. V2 adds unseen-category evaluation through ShapeNet-34 and replaces the supplementary ScanNet examples with ScanObjectNN, KITTI, and randomly cropped ShapeNet-55 examples. These substantially extend the tested input conditions beyond the earlier single-view and indoor-scan evaluations.

E2.justification: V2 adds an actual qualitative comparison with SDS-Complete in supplementary Figure A2. Figure 9 also adds PoinTr, AnchorFormer, and SVDFormer to the existing failure-case comparison. Comparator membership in the retained PCN and ShapeNet-55 tables is unchanged.

E3.justification: The added ShapeNet-34 experiment introduces a 34-seen/21-unseen-category evaluation protocol. New general-partial-cloud examples use informative-view selection, more complex prompts, and larger ControlNet guidance, exemplified by 9.0 versus the main setting of 5.0. The stated protocols and training budgets for the retained benchmarks remain unchanged.

E4.justification: V2 adds quantitative analysis of generalization to unseen categories and qualitative tests under real-scan and random-cropping conditions, replacing the earlier ScanNet case study. Figure 9 extends the failure analysis to competing methods. These substantially broaden robustness analysis, while the existing modality, fusion, filtering, and view-count ablations are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without repeated-run counts, random-seed information, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The additional results do not change uncertainty-reporting practices.

E6.justification: V2 adds the seen/unseen results in Table 3 and new qualitative outcomes, while retaining existing PCDreamer scores and ablation values. Tables 1-2 fill missing HyperCD and CRA-PCN metrics; for example, PCN CRA-PCN gains DCD 0.537 and F1 0.846 entries. The new ShapeNet-55 CRA-PCN DCD entry is printed as '0.0.617', so its intended value remains unclear.

T1.justification: The mathematical constructions and losses in Equations (1)-(9) are retained. Changing CD to LCD in Equation (7) makes notation consistent without altering its definition. No substantive theoretical result, assumption, or proof is added.

C1.justification: The introduction and conclusion withdraw the claim to introduce diffusion priors to point cloud completion 'for the first time'. The central contributions concerning multi-view priors, shape fusion, and confidence-based consolidation remain.

C2.justification: V2 explains the diffusion models' fixed-viewpoint requirement, interprets the unseen-category results as moderately strong generalization, and discusses applicability to general partial clouds. The supplement identifies arbitrary multi-view depth inputs as future work. The existing thin-structure failure limitation remains.

D1.justification: V2 adds a project URL and documents view selection, stronger guidance, and richer prompting for the new input scenarios. It also removes the description of the ResNet backbone as pretrained, leaving initialization less explicit; this does not establish that initialization or training actually changed.

R1.justification: V2 adds Kasten et al.'s diffusion-based completion work, SDS-Complete, and revises the associated priority claim. KITTI and ScanObjectNN references are added while ScanNet is removed. The broader related-work survey remains largely unchanged.

P1.justification: The implementation paragraph moves before the dataset subsection, and Discussion changes from Section 4.3.1 to Section 4.4. Targeted explanations, grammatical corrections, and supplementary rewrites accompany these changes, while most prose and the overall narrative structure are retained.

P2.justification: V2 adds Table 3 and supplementary Figure A2, replaces the ScanNet figure with Figure A1, and expands Figure 9. Existing displays are resized or relocated, and Figure 5's dataset caption is corrected from PCN to ShapeNet-55. Earlier supplementary Figures 2-4 retain identical image content as Figures A3-A5.

improvement.justification: The unseen-category evaluation and SDS-Complete comparison strengthen evidence beyond v1, while withdrawing the first-use claim improves research positioning. These provide a modest net gain. The real-world extensions remain preliminary qualitative examples, and the malformed new CRA-PCN metric and less explicit ResNet initialization description introduce small reporting regressions.
